user.title: ONVIF PTZ camera
user.description: The camera's ONVIF address and login. It must be able to move to absolute positions.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the camera over ONVIF, or it can't pan / tilt / zoom.
error.no_absolute: This camera can't move to absolute positions over ONVIF (only by speed), which PTZ 360 needs.
error.no_position: This camera doesn't report its position over ONVIF, which PTZ 360 needs.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up.

init.title: Video
init.description: Where the picture comes from. Leave both empty for the stream the camera names over ONVIF.

data_description.video_entity: The same camera as another integration sees it, e.g. Frigate's camera (its WebRTC through Frigate's go2rtc). The card shows this entity's picture.
data_description.stream_url: For this integration's own camera entity, instead of the one the camera names over ONVIF. Include the login if it needs one.
